description: Project the future value of a lump sum with compound interest, optionally with a fixed contribution added at the end of every month (a savings plan or SIP). Returns the final value, total contributed, interest earned and a year-by-year balance.

annual_rate_percent.description: Nominal annual rate of return in percent.

compounds_per_year.description: Compounding periods per year (1 annual, 4 quarterly, 12 monthly, 365 daily).

monthly_contribution.description: Amount added at the end of each month.
